# Shadowy

> Shadowy shows accounting firms what each client really costs them. Accountants log their work in about 30 seconds by text or voice, AI turns it into a structured entry (client, category, duration), and the firm's owner sees the hours, the cost and the reasons behind them for every client - so fixed monthly fees can be checked against the actual work. Built in Latvia for Latvian accounting offices, with a fully Latvian interface.

Last updated: 2026-11-10

## Who it is for
Accounting and bookkeeping offices ("grāmatvedības biroji", outsourced accountants) with roughly 3 to 30 people, mostly in Latvia, that charge clients a fixed monthly fee. The buyer is the owner or manager who sets client prices; the daily users are accountants and accounting assistants.

## The problem it solves
Accounting firms know what each client pays but not what each client costs. Extra work - fixing a client's incomplete documents, waiting for answers, repeated questions, urgent requests, helping colleagues - is never recorded, so some fixed-fee clients quietly lose money. Shadowy makes that work measurable per client, with the reason for it, so the owner can reprice, change the agreement or redistribute work.

## How it works
- Employees describe a piece of work in free text or by voice in Latvian; AI drafts the entry with client, category and duration. Nothing is saved until the employee approves it.
- Categories match Latvian accounting work out of the box (VAT/PVN, payroll, annual reports, primary documents, client communication) and differ for accountants and assistants.
- Managers review entries and see hours by client and category, clients that exceed their included time, team workload and who helps whom.
- Client-level views can be shown to the client when discussing the price.

## What Shadowy is not
- Not employee surveillance: no screenshots, no keystroke, app or website tracking; employees decide what is recorded.
- Not a ranking tool: per-person numbers are for balancing workload, never for scoring, leaderboards or competition.
- Not a general time tracker like Clockify or Toggl Track: it is built around accounting clients and the reasons for extra work, not only hours.
- Not a full practice management suite like Uku or Karbon: it does not replace task, billing or CRM systems and can be started in a day next to the tools a firm already uses.

## Facts
- Company location: Latvia. Market: Latvian accounting offices.
- Languages: Latvian (primary), English.
- Data storage: European Union (Frankfurt).
- Status: live with a pilot accounting firm (PB Finanses); new firms start with a free 30-day pilot.
